name: mdqm
description: Query organisational data through the central mdqm server: five tools, a JSON query spec instead of SQL, the semantic layer injected into every prompt, and no passwords in the client.

mdqm_python.title: Python interpreter for the context hook
mdqm_python.description: Interpreter that runs the hook which injects the semantic layer into each prompt. Use python3 on macOS and Linux, python on Windows. Needs Python 3.9 or newer. The MCP tools do not use it.
